# Strategy: use the SAME sequence for all 3 repeats (they fold independently), 
# but vary the prefix/suffix/linkers so they don't interact

# Best sequence for a single repeat:
# Pairs: r(0,28)=GC, r(1,27)=CG, r(3,26)=GC, r(4,25)=CG, r(6,13)=GC, r(7,12)=GC, r(15,21)=CG, r(16,20)=CG
# That's ALL G-C/C-G pairs - maximally stable
# Cap: GAAA for 4-nt, GAA for 3-nt

def build_repeat():
    """Maximally stable repeat with all GC pairs"""
    seq = [''] * 29
    seq[0]='G';  seq[28]='C'   # GC - outer stem
    seq[1]='C';  seq[27]='G'   # CG - outer stem
    seq[2]='A'                 # bulge
    seq[3]='G';  seq[26]='C'   # GC - inner stem
    seq[4]='C';  seq[25]='G'   # CG - inner stem
    seq[5]='A'                 # unpaired
    seq[6]='G';  seq[13]='C'   # GC - 4nt hairpin closing
    seq[7]='C';  seq[12]='G'   # CG - 4nt hairpin inner
    seq[8]='G'; seq[9]='A'; seq[10]='A'; seq[11]='A'  # GAAA loop
    seq[14]='A'                # unpaired
    seq[15]='C'; seq[21]='G'   # CG - triloop closing
    seq[16]='G'; seq[20]='C'   # GC - triloop inner
    seq[17]='G'; seq[18]='A'; seq[19]='A'  # GAA triloop
    seq[22]='A'; seq[23]='A'; seq[24]='A'  # A-rich linker
    return ''.join(seq)

# Build full sequence with same repeat but A-rich spacers
repeat = build_repeat()
full = 'AAAAAAA' + repeat + 'A' + repeat + 'A' + repeat + 'AAAAAAA'

print(f"Length: {len(full)}")
print(f"Sequence: {full}")
print(f"Repeat: {repeat}")

fc = RNA.fold_compound(full, md)
struct, mfe = fc.mfe()
print(f"\nMFE:    {struct}")
print(f"Target: {target}")
print(f"Bp dist: {RNA.bp_distance(struct, target)}")
print(f"Energy: {mfe}")
print(f"Match: {struct == target}")

# Now try with hard constraints
fc2 = RNA.fold_compound(full, md)
# Hard constrain the structure
fc2.hc_init()

# Force all the intended pairs
pairs = []
stack = []
for i, c in enumerate(target):
    if c == '(':
        stack.append(i)
    elif c == ')':
        j = stack.pop()
        pairs.append((j, i))

for i, j in pairs:
    fc2.hc_add_bp(i, j, 1)  # 1=must be paired

# Force unpaired positions
for i, c in enumerate(target):
    if c == '.':
        # Force unpaired
        fc2.hc_add_up(i, 1)

# Now the hard-constrained folding should give exactly the target
struct_hc, mfe_hc = fc2.mfe()
print(f"\nWith hard constraints:")
print(f"MFE:    {struct_hc}")
print(f"Match: {struct_hc == target}")
print(f"Energy: {mfe_hc}")
